pages: The billing service runs in the shared cluster and is owned by team-a. Its request timeout is 5 seconds. The billing connection pool holds 10 connections. Failed billing requests are retried 2 times before the request is moved to the dead-letter queue. Restarting billing requires draining the queue first.
